scripts.build: pnpm resolve-dependencies && pnpm exec lz-tool --script 'bash scripts/sbf-build.sh anchor build --ignore-keys && add_address_to_idl.py' anchor && pnpm allow-read-write
scripts.build:composer: pnpm resolve-dependencies && pnpm exec lz-tool --script 'bash scripts/sbf-build.sh anchor build -p example_composer --ignore-keys' anchor
scripts.build:native: pnpm resolve-dependencies && pnpm exec lz-tool --docker-platform native --script 'bash scripts/sbf-build.sh anchor build --ignore-keys && add_address_to_idl.py' anchor && pnpm allow-read-write
scripts.build:oft: pnpm resolve-dependencies && pnpm exec lz-tool --script 'bash scripts/sbf-build.sh anchor build -p console_oft --ignore-keys' anchor
scripts.build:sdk: pnpm idl:build && pnpm artifacts:copy && pnpm generate:sdk
scripts.format: pnpm exec lz-tool --script 'cargo +nightly-2025-06-01 fmt -p console-oft' anchor
scripts.format:check: pnpm exec lz-tool --script 'cargo +nightly-2025-06-01 fmt -p console-oft -- --check' anchor
scripts.idl:build:composer: pnpm resolve-dependencies && mkdir -p build && pnpm exec lz-tool --script 'anchor idl build -p example_composer -o build/example_composer.json' anchor
scripts.idl:build:composer:native: pnpm resolve-dependencies && mkdir -p build && pnpm exec lz-tool --docker-platform native --script 'anchor idl build -p example_composer -o build/example_composer.json' anchor
scripts.idl:build:oft: pnpm resolve-dependencies && mkdir -p build && pnpm exec lz-tool --script 'anchor idl build -p console_oft -o build/console_oft.json && add_address_to_idl.py --idl-dir build' anchor
scripts.idl:build:oft:native: pnpm resolve-dependencies && mkdir -p build && pnpm exec lz-tool --docker-platform native --script 'anchor idl build -p console_oft -o build/console_oft.json && add_address_to_idl.py --idl-dir build' anchor
scripts.lint: pnpm resolve-dependencies && pnpm format:check && pnpm exec lz-tool --script 'cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings' anchor && eslint . --max-warnings 0 --ignore-pattern target/
scripts.test: pnpm test:rust && pnpm test:sdk && pnpm test:validator
scripts.test:mollusk: pnpm build:test-fixtures && pnpm exec lz-tool --script 'cargo test -p console-oft --tests' anchor
scripts.test:policy: pnpm build:test-fixtures && pnpm exec lz-tool --script 'cargo test -p console-oft --test oft_pubkey_policy --locked && cargo test -p console-oft-integration-tests --locked' anchor
scripts.test:rust: pnpm build:test-fixtures && pnpm exec lz-tool --script 'cargo test -p console-oft -p console-oft-integration-tests --locked' anchor
scripts.test:unit: pnpm resolve-dependencies && pnpm exec lz-tool --script 'cargo test -p console-oft --lib' anchor
